name: a custom icon card with a colour swatch row and a free badge
looks: A small bright badge reading 'free' spins and settles onto the corner of a square icon card. Underneath, a name field sits filled in, and a row of small colour swatches fans out, one of them held with a bright selection ring.
build: The badge rotates in from an angle and settles (back.out); the swatch row's circles pop in on a short even stagger; the selected swatch's ring scales in with a spring the instant it's picked.
sound: A light whoosh as the badge spins in, a soft tick per swatch landing, a brighter chime on the selection ring.
prompt: Spin a small 'free' badge onto the corner of a square icon card, then fan out a row of colour swatches beneath a filled name field, with one swatch getting a bright selection ring the instant it's chosen, to show a personal, customisable creation.
